augmentation.assignment: SHA256 of seed:flow_id, first8 bytes modulo3. One signed per-gap offset for each flow, reused for all training prefixes; first gap stays zero and values are clipped to schema bounds. No additional rows or weights.

selection: Seed17 control must reproduce existing forest bytes and all473 saved baseline probabilities before candidate fitting. Evaluate clean and abstract plus/minus stress identically for both. If any gate fails on seed17 stop without alternate fits. If seed17 passes, fit the same two fixed arms at seeds42 and123 with identical examples and augmentation assignments; require all gates at every seed. No post-result grid, threshold, change of recipe or automatic activation.
roles: Exactly the previous 14000 public train and79 role-bound local training flows (including17 Spotify); four equally weighted prefix views and identical public/local sample weights. Reuse previously exposed local selection (10 YouTube,7 Instagram,4 Spotify) and the previous452 public first10 selection cases. No public calibration/test, prior local calibration/final or final policy recordings. Model and normalizer frozen for inference; no label or endpoint features.
limits: One paired forest pilot with fixed conditional repetitions. Gap offsets are abstract metadata augmentation, not observed network behavior or validated protocol simulation. Reused local selection was exposed to earlier decisions and is not a fresh final test; flows within visits are correlated. Stress improvement on these views alone is not robust deployment evidence. No paid resources, automatic live capture, new calibration, label acceptance, default promotion or publishing.
